title: Grateful Dead Live at Roscoe Maples Pavilion - Stanford University on 1973-02-09
source: MR 2 Track Reel > 7.5 IPS 1/4 tack dolby B reel > DAT > Sonic Solutions > CDR

ai_review.summary: Energetic early‑1973 Palo Alto show with a standout 'Eyes of the World', captured on a soundboard but hindered by noticeable dead‑space gaps between songs.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its high energy and long, intricate renditions—especially an extended 'Eyes of the World' that many reviewers call a highlight. The recording is a soundboard source; while generally clear, listeners note repetitive silence (dead space) after each track that detracts from the listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Average review rating is 4.2/5, with strong positive comments about the show and only minor technical complaints about dead‑space gaps.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear overall sound but contains consistent dead‑space/silence after each song, likely due to taper's tape handling or editing.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows with high energy; early versions of songs that later became favorites are performed with enthusiasm, capturing the band at a peak in their Palo Alto home turf.
